snippet.title: CUFFBUST - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play CUFFBUST:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2592220/CUFFBUST/
Merch:  https://www.cuffbust.com/
Discord:  https://discord.gg/wm8VbGSsuw

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Check out my Link Tree, with links to my game Choo-Choo Charles, and my other socials!
https://linktr.ee/TwoStarGames
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CUFFBUST is the new upcoming multiplayer co-op prison escape game for PC, coming to Steam next year, in 2025 (i think lol).  This new indie game is developed by Gavin Eisenbeisz (Two Star Games), creator of Choo-Choo Charles, No Snake Hotel, My Beautiful Paper Smile, Cloud Climber, and My Friend is a Raven.  In this gamedev indie development devlog part 1 I'll be adding tons of new features to my dream game in ,one week 24 hours, 30 days, one year, or maybe some other amount of time idk.
